content:
anika: spotted a latency tail starting ~22:07 UTC, lots of 503s for small-chat endpoints
ben: confirmed, p95 jumps to 900ms, p99 > 2.1s. Graph at https://grafana.internal/reports/xyz
devon: cloud notifications show preemptions in us-west1-a, but only on ephemeral-GPU classes
kai: logs show KV cache miss storms after pod restarts — cache warming + batching combo killing latency
anika: can we failover traffic to dedicated pool? How much spare capacity?
ben: ~15 dGPUs free in us-west1, but they are higher cost. Can warm a few replicas.
devon: orch-bot, can you cordon the affected spot pool and scale up on-demand?
orch-bot: queued action: cordon pool spot-gpu-ephemeral-03 -> success
orch-bot: queued action: scale deployment small-chat-v2 to 6 -> success
kai: deploying smaller batch config to reduce tail, applying config: `BATCH_MAX=4 BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=40`
anika: rolling change to 2 nodes in dedicated pool for immediate relief
ben: adding a short lived prefix cache dump to mitigate cold-starts: `curl -X POST https://small-chat/api/cache/prime` -> 200 OK
devon: seeing drop in p99 after scale+prime, still a few 503s from stragglers
kai: suggestion: set prefer_on_demand routing for small-chat in us-west1 for next 6h
anika: agree. Ben, estimate cost impact for 6 hours
ben: rough calc +$380 for 6h at current traffic, but keeps latency under SLO
anika: go ahead. also open ticket to investigate eviction correlation with host maintenance windows
devon: created jira INF-4321 with logs attached
sre-bot: incident annotated: priority=high, mitigation=scaled to dedicated, routing override, cache prime
anika: thanks all. keep thread updated if error rate spikes again :thumbsup:
